title.zh: 为Cotabato市增设两名助理检察官，为此修订Cotabato市宪章第23条的法案
title.en: An Act to Provide Two Assistant Attorneys for the City of Cotabato, Amending for the Purpose Section Twenty-Three of the Charter of the City of Cotabato
title.orig: An Act to Provide Two Assistant Attorneys for the City of Cotabato, Amending for the Purpose Section Twenty-Three of the Charter of the City of Cotabato

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1961/ra_3332_1961.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
The first paragraph of Section twenty-three of Republic Act Numbered Twenty-three hundred sixty-four, otherwise known as the "Charter of the City of Cotabato," is amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 23. The city attorney His compensation, powers and duties. The provisions of Commonwealth Act Numbered Four hundred nine to the contrary notwithstanding, the city shall have an attorney who shall be the chief legal adviser of the city. He shall have two assistant attorneys with compensation at the rate of four thousand two hundred pesos and three thousand seven hundred twenty pesos, respectively per annum. Said assistant attorneys shall be appointed by the President of the Philippines with the consent of the Commission on Appointments. The city attorney shall have the following powers and duties."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted, without Executive approval, June 18, 1961.
